data_intended_use: Training and evaluation of a pet-owner-language condition-category pre-assessment classifier; not epidemiology or diagnosis.

sources.name: repository-local curated records
sources.license: repository-controlled; verify upstream rights before release

class_coverage: All labels must have owner-language evaluation support before promotion; enforced by eval coverage and release gates.
species_register_coverage: Owner-language dog/cat symptom descriptions; unsupported species and clinical shorthand are not release claims.
synthetic_proportion: Recorded by each immutable dataset manifest; synthetic rows require leakage, similarity, provenance, and manual-review gates.
transformations_exclusions: Text/labels are normalized centrally, content-deduplicated, schema-validated, and grouped before splitting. Invalid, duplicate, leakage-prone, and diagnosis-leaking rows are rejected with counts.
known_data_gaps: No claim of population representativeness, clinical outcome validity, rare-species coverage, or multilingual coverage.
model_intended_use: Cautious condition-category pre-assessment used only with deterministic triage, abstention, and advice-safety policy.
prohibited_use: diagnosis, prescribing, autonomous treatment, emergency de-escalation, or replacing veterinary care.
active_backend: quantized ONNX on Lambda; Torch is the reference backend
dataset_evidence: dataset build manifest plus immutable split manifest
rollback_version: Declared in each release-manifest.json; never inferred from latest
evaluation_evidence: Release evaluation reports explicit labels, per-class/segment metrics, confusion matrix, coverage, and baseline deltas. Current local baseline is documented in docs/baseline-2026-07-07.md.
calibration_evidence: Versioned thresholds and selective-accuracy evidence are required in the promoted bundle.
safety_evidence: data/safety_eval.json must pass; Torch/ONNX parity must meet configs/release-gates.json.
model_limitations: Confidence is not clinical probability. Performance may degrade on unseen phrasing, species, conditions, languages, or distribution shift. The deterministic safety layer remains authoritative.
clinical_status: Not clinically validated; veterinary approval metadata is required for advice content.
